recipient-country.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria operates using an allocation model. Countries are allocated pots of money, per disease for a three year period. In this case of Afghanistan, the actual available pot of money is 65,537,654 and the actual value date is Wednesday, September 21, 2022 This amount covers the period 2023-2025. Data in the recipient-country-budget element has been formatted to adhear to the schema rules.
